messages:
maria: FYI Datadog asked for a short integration doc for the Private Marketplace tile: SLI probe example + what we redact from sample telemetry. Can we align here? cc @ddliaison :wave:

ddliaison: Thanks! Legal wants a concise note listing potential PII in traces/metrics and our redaction approach. Ops/obs need to confirm probe endpoints and allowed test payloads.

vikram: Clarify scope — are we covering OTLP/traces only or also metrics export and tags? I can add label-sanitization rules for metrics if we need them.

danielle: We should cover both. The deliverables: 1) opt-in enablement text for customers, 2) a drop-in YAML probe example for canary deployments, 3) our redaction steps + sample regexes for doc. I have a first-pass regex.

sam: Ops constraint: probes must never hit prod model endpoints. Use a dedicated canary model endpoint (staging/canary), enforce rate limiting, and document an IP allowlist for customers who need to originate probes from their VPC.

maria: Datadog also wants a short runbook snippet for "probe data not appearing in tile" — one-paragraph troubleshooting steps.

ddliaison: I'll include Datadog-side expectations (API key scope, ingest endpoints, a sample query and the expected ingestion lag). Also will attach recommended SLO thresholds for the tile view.

danielle: Draft redaction examples to include in doc:
````
# redact common PII-like fields in exported samples
s/username=[^\s]+/username=[REDACTED]/g
s/email=[^\s]+/email=[REDACTED]/g
s/prompt_text=(.{1024,})/prompt_text=[TRUNCATED]/g
````
Recommend truncating any free-text fields longer than 1k chars before sending sample payloads.

vikram: For metrics/tag hygiene: namespace internal labels with rw_ and drop values matching long hex/blob patterns. Eg:
````
metric_label_filters = [r"[0-9a-f]{32,}", r"[0-9a-f]{64}"]
# drop labels that match these patterns before export
````
Also propose mapping internal feature flags to rw_ff_* labels so they don't collide with customer tags.

sam: Runbook snippet (short):
1) Confirm probe VM can reach DD ingest: `curl -I -sS https://http-intake.logs.datadoghq.com` with PROBE_API_KEY set
2) Check probe logs: `sudo tail -n100 /var/log/rw-telemetry/probe.log` look for `probe.emit` and `probe.error`
3) In Datadog UI -> Metrics Explorer: run query `avg:rw.marketplace.probe.latency{env:canary}` expect <200ms; if no data, check API key scope and firewall rules.

maria: Two quick items before I send to Legal/Marketing: a one-line customer-facing privacy blurb and a single YAML probe example customers can copy into their CI.

danielle: Customer privacy blurb (suggestion): "Redwood collects only diagnostic telemetry required to operate the Marketplace tile; PII is redacted by default and customers can opt in to share additional diagnostics for troubleshooting."

vikram: Canary YAML example (drop-in) — uses a dedicated canary endpoint and token env var:
````
# rw-probe-canary.yml
probe:
  id: rw-market-canary-01
  endpoint: https://canary.private.redwood.ai/v1/telemetry/probe
  method: POST
  headers:
    Authorization: "Bearer ${PROBE_TOKEN}"
    Content-Type: application/json
  body: '{"type":"sli_probe","probe_id":"rw-market-canary-01","payload":"sli-check"}'
  cadence: 1m
  timeout_ms: 5000
````
This should be safe for staging/canary only.

ddliaison: Datadog query snippet to include in docs:
````
# python snippet for example queries
from datadog import initialize, api
q = "avg:rw.marketplace.probe.latency{env:canary} by {host}"
res = api.Metric.query(start=START_TS, end=END_TS, query=q)
````
And note: expected ingestion lag ~15-30s for the tile. I'll add SLOs: P50 < 150ms, P95 < 400ms for canary probes.

sam: FYI deploy-bot just finished the probe-service canary deploy in staging. Use the PROBE_TOKEN from 1Password if you want to run an ad-hoc test.

deploy-bot: deploy success: probe-service-staging @ 3943216805 :white_check_mark:

maria: Plan for owners: @danielle will fold regex + YAML + privacy blurb into the integration doc; @vikram will add metric label filters and confirmation of export metric paths; @ddliaison will attach Datadog query examples + SLOs; @sam will add runbook and IP allowlist text. I'll collate and send to Legal & Marketing tomorrow EOD. Any objections?

ddliaison: No objections. Please cc me on the legal review thread.

danielle: I'll drop the draft in the integration doc and ping when ready: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (internal link)

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
